derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626 (ἀπολογέομαι);

occurrences.text: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
